did.unittitle: David Rockefeller papers, Office Files, Political Files

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Consists of correspondence with and contributions to political candidates, campaigns, and elected officials. Often includes requests for support, invitations to fundraisers or associated events.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research in accordance with the terms of donation from the David Rockefeller Estate, January 2019. Brittle or damaged items are available at the discretion of RAC.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Original order, as received. Records are arranged in series by state.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Expedited Access - Processing Level 1 - File-Level Access.
Some records remain in original housing. Additional processing will be conducted in the future to improve description, enhance access, and long-term preservation.
